subject: 222 Boston Avenue Demolition Approval
overview: The commission held a preferably preserved hearing for 222 Boston Avenue and three significance hearings for other properties. The body ultimately cleared 222 Boston Avenue for demolition, approved the 2022 annual report, and discussed potential revisions to the city demolition ordinance with the Building Commissioner.

items.title: 222 Boston Avenue Preferably Preserved Hearing
items.summary: The commission voted that the property is not preferably preserved, allowing demolition to proceed contingent upon archival documentation of the structure.

items.title: Tabled Hearing for 91 Winchester Street
items.summary: The preferably preserved hearing for the carriage house was tabled until the next meeting because required signage was not posted.

items.title: 12 George Street Significance Hearing
items.summary: The commission voted that the property is not historically significant, allowing a partial demolition and renovation project to move forward.

items.title: 28 Winter Street Significance Hearing
items.summary: The property was found not historically significant due to lost architectural integrity.

items.title: 17 Green Road Significance Hearing
items.summary: The commission found the property historically significant due to its architectural integrity and association with the Green family, and it will proceed to a preferably preserved hearing next month.

items.title: 142 Mystic Avenue Demolition Application
items.summary: The commission accepted the demolition application for a proposed beer hall and authorized funding for a Form B survey to review its significance.

items.title: Approval of 2022 Annual Report
items.summary: The board approved its annual report after adding clarifying language regarding the expedited lifting of demolition delays for owners who engage in good-faith design revisions.

items.title: Ongoing Demolition Delay Reviews
items.summary: The subcommittee requested further refinements to window placements and gables for 31 South Street and discussed scheduling a separate meeting for 28 Grove Street.

items.title: Building Commissioner and Ordinance Discussion
items.summary: The commission discussed inviting the Building Commissioner to the next meeting to review potential revisions to the demolition ordinance, specifically regarding partial demolitions and legal enforcement.

items.title: CPA Projects and Survey Updates
items.summary: The commission received updates on the restoration of Palm's Wall, tree maintenance at Thomas Brooks Park, and the status of survey contracts for Fulton Heights and the Brickyards.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The commission approved the meeting minutes for March 2023.
